title: Retention profiles and evidence workflow for request telemetry (prompts/responses/logs/metrics)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Define per-customer retention profiles and automated evidence/reporting for prompts, responses, request logs, and telemetry metrics. Deliver a spec, Console UI/API for configuring retention windows by data type and residency, an evidence-generation pipeline (export + signed deletion certificates), and runtime controls for legal holds and overrides.
background: Enterprise customers require explicit controls and auditable evidence for how long PII and request telemetry are kept. Existing base retention defaults (30d) are insufficient for enterprise SLAs and data residency requirements. This ticket consolidates product requirements, trade-offs, and acceptance criteria for retention profiles and evidence automation.
design_considerations: - Data-plane vs control-plane separation: retention enforcement should be implemented close to the storage layer (e.g., per-bucket lifecycle) while control and UI live in the control plane. - Residency: retention windows may differ by region; must tag data with customer-residency attribute at ingest. - Legal hold: support temporary override that prevents automatic purge. - Evidence: produce signed, timestamped certificates with log of deletion operations and exported artifacts. - Scalability: prefer lifecycle policies and async background workers over per-event sync deletes to avoid latency spikes.
tradeoffs_and_risks: - Per-customer per-object TTL increases metadata complexity and storage costs. To reduce complexity we will implement per-customer lifecycle policies with coarse-grained buckets (prompts/responses/metrics/logs). - Full delete-on-demand adds risk of extended SLOs; we prefer queued deletion with SLA. - Evidence generation may increase storage (archives) for export prior to deletion; we will compress and time-box archives.
acceptance_criteria: Spec document with API and Console wireframes approved by legal and security
Console allows creating/updating retention profiles for prompts, responses, request logs, and metrics, scoped to customer and residency
API endpoints for listing and applying retention profiles documented in OpenAPI
Automated weekly evidence export CSV/PARQ for deleted data with signed deletion certificate
End-to-end test: create profile (90d), ingest sample data, mark legal hold, verify no deletion; remove legal hold and verify deletion and certificate generation
Smoke test: apply 30s TTL in staging to verify lifecycle worker deletes and certificate is generated
